name: Flyte
tagline: Code simulated drones and train AI models in your browser
description: Flyte teaches children aged 6–17 coding, drone controls and AI through block programming and a 3D flight simulator. It runs free in a browser with no drone kit required.

name: Arnson Innovate
tagline: Hands-on STEM learning and tech solutions for Ghanaian schools
description: Arnson Innovate equips STEM centres and teaches robotics, coding, AI and drone technology. The Ghanaian company also builds custom software and provides IT consultancy.

name: Sankofa Job
tagline: Find jobs and short gigs across Ghana
description: Sankofa Job helps workers browse jobs and short gigs, build a skills profile and connect with employers. It is free for job seekers and operated by G&T Prestige Ltd in Kumasi.
